```go
package greeter

import "strings"

// Slug 把文本转成小写、以单个连字符分隔的 slug。
func Slug(s string) string {
	return strings.Join(strings.Fields(strings.ToLower(s)), "-")
}
```

strings.Fields splits on any whitespace and ignores leading/trailing, so Slug("  Hello World  ") -> fields ["Hello","World"] -> lower -> join "hello-world". Slug("a   b") -> "a-b". Good. Slug("") -> "". That's reasonable.
